calibration_summary: ONFI 4.1 specifies several host-driven calibration loops for high-speed source-synchronous operation. (1) ZQ Calibration (Long F9h, Short D9h) — calibrates output driver impedance against external RZQ reference. (2) NV-DDR3 DCC Training (18h Implicit) — duty-cycle correction on internal clock. (3) NV-DDR3 Read DQ Training (62h) — host sweeps RX sampling phase against fixed device-driven training pattern. (4) NV-DDR3 Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern + 64h readback) — round-trip pattern verification for write-side TX adjustment. (5) NV-DDR3 Write RX DQ Training (76h) — device performs per-DQ RX training. (6) Set Features I/O Drive Strength (EFh + 10h) — programs output driver strength settings. All other electrical parameters (Vcc / VccQ rails, signal integrity, channel impedance) are characterized by the host designer but require no closed-loop trim with the device.

zq_calibration_long.purpose: Calibrate output driver impedance after Reset / power-on / data-interface change.
zq_calibration_long.prerequisite: Vcc / VccQ stable; data interface = NV-DDR2 or NV-DDR3 (Set Features 01h).
host_actions: Issue Read Status (70h); check FAIL bit; FAIL=1 → calibration failed.

zq_calibration_short.purpose: Periodic V/T drift correction; faster than ZQ Long.
host_actions: Issue Read Status; check FAIL bit.
zq_calibration_short.recommended_interval: Per device-reported tZQCS_interval; typically every 128 ms or after a temperature delta.

dcc_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Duty-cycle correction on internal clock for NV-DDR3 high-speed modes.
dcc_training_nv_ddr3.command: Implicit DCC Training (18h) — issued during initialization after data-interface switch.

read_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Find optimal host-side RX sampling phase across DQ[7:0] using device-driven training pattern.
procedure: Device outputs known training pattern on DQ during DQS edges.
Host sweeps RX sampling phase across each DQ lane.
Host records pass/fail per phase per DQ; selects center of pass window per DQ.
Host stores per-DQ delay-line values for subsequent reads.

write_tx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Find optimal host TX phase per DQ lane via round-trip pattern verification.
write_tx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.command_pattern: Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h) — host writes a training pattern to the device.
write_tx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.command_readback: Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h) — device returns the previously written pattern; host compares.
procedure: Host issues 63h + pattern (per-DQ different phase under test).
Host issues 64h to read back what the device captured.
Host compares per-DQ; non-matching = capture failure at that TX phase.
Iterate sweep; pick TX phase center of pass window per DQ.

write_rx_dq_training_nv_ddr3.purpose: Device performs per-DQ RX calibration using host-driven pattern.
procedure: Device adjusts internal RX delay lines; reports completion via R/B_n / Status.

io_drive_strength_calibration.purpose: Adjust output driver strength to match channel impedance and load.
io_drive_strength_calibration.command: Set Features (EFh + 10h I/O Drive Strength) + 4 P-bytes.
host_actions: Sweep candidate drive-strength settings; for each, run Read DQ Training; pick the strength with the largest pass window.

no_internal_trim_exposed: ONFI does not expose any internal analog trim register (charge-pump trim, sense-amp reference, read-margining) on the host interface. Those are vendor-internal and not visible to the host.

power_up_characterization.purpose: Allow internal regulators / DLL / DCC to stabilize before host issues first command.

notes: ONFI 4.1 calibration is entirely host-driven; the device exposes training-pattern emit (Read DQ Training) and round-trip pattern (Write TX DQ Training) plus a ZQ impedance loop. The host owns the optimization loops (RX phase sweep, TX phase sweep, drive-strength sweep, periodic ZQ recalibration). Internal trim (sense-amp reference, bit-line precharge, charge-pump targets for Program/Erase) is factory-set and not exposed via ONFI.
